hero-description.value: Responsible trading practices across our supply chain operations.

section-1-body-1.value: AFGT integrates sustainability considerations into commodity sourcing, supply chain management, and trading operations. The company works with partners who maintain recognized environmental and social standards.

section-1-body-2.value: Sustainability practices are assessed through supplier audits, certification verification, and operational monitoring across the supply chain.

section-1-body-3.value: The company prioritizes long-term partnerships with producers and logistics providers who demonstrate commitment to sustainable practices and transparent operations.

section-1-body-4.value: AFGT participates in industry initiatives aimed at improving sustainability standards across global commodity markets.
